description: This file defines the PHP class 'Cheque' within the OpenCart extension for the catalog payment model. The class extends the system engine model and provides a method to retrieve available payment methods for cheque payments, handling configuration and geographical zone checks.

classes.name: Cheque
classes.description: Represents the cheque payment method within the OpenCart catalog extension.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Returns available cheque payment methods based on store configurations and geographic zone restrictions.
